name: Knysna Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Coastal southern south africa (western cape eastward to far southern kwazulu-natal)
description: A furtive woodpecker with densely spotted underparts and face. The male has a reddish crown and moustache; the female has a faint dark moustache and dark crown marked red only toward the back of the head.

name: Zamboanga Bulbul
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (basilan and zamboanga peninsula of western mindanao)
description: A medium-sized bird of foothill forest and edge in western Mindanao and on adjacent islands. Dark brown above with a grayish-brown streaked crown, a white belly, white under the base of the tail, and a warm reddish-brown throat, cheek, and chest.

name: Little Paradise-Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Southern new guinea (merauke to fly river), including aru islands (off southwestern new guinea)
description: A little-known, long-tailed kingfisher of riverine forests. White underparts and rump, black mask, deep blue wing, pale blue cap, red bill and long tail.

name: Dusky Nightjar
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Small dark nightjar with very limited range in the highlands of Costa Rica and Panama. Few obvious plumage features: entire body is intricately patterned with dark brown, black, and buff.

name: Atlantic Plain-Xenops
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (north to southern bahia) to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Active small bird of humid tropical forest. Usually found singly, often moving with mixed-species feeding flocks.

name: Gilolo Fantail
rangeDescription: Northern moluccas (halmahera, ternate, bacan, and obi)
description: Small, active songbird with long, pale-tipped tail and warm brownish-orange on the forehead, rump, and tail base. Grayish brown above and pale below overall, with a white throat and black-speckled breast.

name: Blue-fronted Parrotlet
rangeDescription: Humid eastern panama to northwestern venezuela and northwestern ecuador
description: Small, short-tailed parrot that occurs from Venezuela to Ecuador and into eastern Panama. Green overall with a pale bluish eyering and red patches around the eye.

name: Santa Marta Antpitta
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Plump, terrestrial bird found only in the Santa Marta Mountains of Colombia. Like other antpittas, it is short-tailed and long-legged.

name: Donaldson Smith's Nightjar
rangeDescription: Northwestern and southern somalia, eastern and southern ethiopia, eastern kenya, and northeastern tanzania; possibly also in southeastern south sudan
description: A small, pretty nightjar with rufous tones in the plumage. Both sexes have small pale marks in the outer wings and at the corners of the tail.

name: Blue-billed Black-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil to uruguay, eastern paraguay, and northeastern argentina
description: Large, crestless flycatcher found along the borders of humid forests and in gallery forests, often close to water. Male is mostly glossy black, while females are brown above with a cinnamon rump and buffy below with heavy brown streaks.

name: Sumatran Drongo
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of sumatra
description: Glossy large-billed drongo with glossy blue-sheened wings and tail. Also note bright red eyes, iridescent speckling around the throat and neck, and flared broad-tipped tail.

name: Tschudi's Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Central andes of peru (eastern la libertad to junín)
description: Small tapaculo of high-elevation cloud forest in the eastern Andes of northern and central Peru. Male is uniformly gray; female is paler and browner with extensive buffy barring.

name: White-crowned Cuckoo
rangeDescription: New guinea, including salawati (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A large cuckoo of lowland and hill forest. All black apart from white crown stripe and some pale edged undertail feathers.

name: Emei Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Southwestern china (mount emei shan in sichuan)
description: Brightly-marked medium-sized leaf warbler. Bright yellow-green above with two long yellow wingbars, white underparts, a broad yellowish eyebrow, and a pale crown stripe.

name: Jamaican Elaenia
rangeDescription: Jamaica
description: A rather small woodland flycatcher that is easily overlooked. It is the only flycatcher in its range with a short white eyebrow and no wingbars.

name: Iringa Akalat
rangeDescription: Dry montane forest of south-central tanzania
description: A rather small, demure understory denizen resembling a cross between a robin and a flycatcher. Mostly dull brown with a buffy throat and a short eyebrow.

name: Socotra Cisticola
rangeDescription: Socotra (off eastern somalia)
description: Small, pale brown, heavily streaked cisticola. Endemic to Socotra, where it inhabits low shrublands and other habitats with significant bushy cover, mostly at low elevations.

name: Yucatan Wren
rangeDescription: Arid coastal lowlands of southeastern mexico (northern yucatán peninsula)
description: Large, boldly marked wren of dry coastal scrub along north coast of the Yucatan Peninsula; no similar species in its range. Found in pairs or small groups, usually in areas with cactus plants.

name: Yellow-thighed Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Unique sooty-gray bird with odd yellow tufts of feathers at the base of each leg. Darker black on head and wings.

name: Sula Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Sula islands (taliabu, seho, and mangole)
description: A large, long-tailed green fruit-dove with pale grayish underparts, except for a deep maroon undertail and a small dark throat patch. A bird of the canopy and subcanopy of forested lowlands and less often foothills.
